rca of the issue: BrokerageAutoMailCard crash: `useEffect(load, [])` where `load = () => api.get(...).then(...).catch(...)`. The arrow-fn implicit-returns the axios Promise. React 19 in StrictMode treats the return value of a useEffect callback as the cleanup function and on unmount/double-invoke calls it as a function — calling a Promise as a function throws 'destroy is not a function'. Fix: wrap in a block-bodied arrow so the effect returns undefined: `useEffect(() => { load(); }, []);`.
